sections.title: Semantic Validator
sections.objective: Add cross-record semantic checks to the existing validator using the FS-02 normative schemas. Validate lifecycle state, authorization consistency, orchestrator and writer references, transition legality, required evidence references, and exact authorized commit scope. Produce concise deterministic diagnostics.
required_tests: Valid cross-record lifecycle and authorization relationships pass.
Each inconsistent relationship fails with one concise diagnostic.
The complete repository test suite passes.
explicit_exclusions: No lifecycle writes or transition execution.
No repository mutation by the validator.

sections.title: Read-only floppyctl
sections.objective: Add a thin read-only CLI exposing only status, validate, and inspect over existing validation functions.
explicit_exclusions: No packaging, export, push, merge, integration, release, tag, migration, or production action.
required_tests: status reports lifecycle and authorization state without writes
validate preserves existing validator results and diagnostics
inspect reads only a selected registered record without writes
invalid commands and arguments fail concisely

sections.title: Closeout-completeness rules
sections.objective: Add closeout-completeness rules to the existing validator and CLI.
required_tests: Exact focused test inventory is deferred until FS-05 begins from the then-controlling repository state.

sections.title: Read-only authorization and Git-integrity checks
sections.objective: Add read-only authorization and Git-integrity checks.
explicit_exclusions: Use Git directly. No Git abstraction, repository transaction, lock manager, or custom work-package hashing.

sections.title: Package-Content Scanning
sections.objective: Add a small deterministic content scan used only for boot packages, handoffs, and exports.
explicit_exclusions: No DLP platform, entropy engine, credential manager, or repository-security platform.

sections.title: Boot-Package Generation
sections.objective: Validate and scan the required context, create one checksum manifest, and produce one ZIP.
explicit_exclusions: Reuse FS-07. No signing, registry, upload service, or multiple archive formats.

sections.title: Controlled Lifecycle Writes
sections.objective: Support only FS-01-defined transitions with dry-run output, exact authorized paths, clean-state verification, pre-write validation, and atomic file replacement.
explicit_exclusions: Git is the recovery boundary. No rollback engine, recovery journal, transaction coordinator, branch-restoration system, or generic mutation framework.

sections.title: Targeted Migration
sections.objective: Implement only migration paths for real prior Floppy formats proven by an actual source fixture. If no real migration is required, close with verification and no reusable-product changes.
sections.product_scope_rule: At most three implementation/test paths plus one real source-format fixture per accepted migration path.
explicit_exclusions: No generic migration framework, migration language, plugin system, hypothetical version matrix, or separate rollback system.

sections.title: Final-Project Closure
sections.objective: Add final-project closure as one validated operation using the existing validator, CLI, and controlled-write implementation.
explicit_exclusions: No separate closure engine or duplicate transition implementation.

sections.title: Export and Integrity
sections.objective: Export and verify one portable ZIP containing the accepted context and one integrity manifest.
explicit_exclusions: Reuse FS-08 packaging. No history compaction, archival service, synchronization, hosting, signing, or multiple export formats.

fs_05_work_package_draft.title: Closeout-completeness rules
fs_05_work_package_draft.objective: Add closeout-completeness rules to the existing validator and expose the same result through the existing read-only CLI validation path.
required_tests: complete accepted and applied closeout passes
missing implementation or verification evidence fails concisely
